title: Nina Kulagina stops the hearts of animals
summary: Lyn Buchanan tells of Nina Kulagina stops the hearts of animals, about Soviet era at Soviet Union, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Um, the Russians after they got all of this had a woman named Nina Cologa who was stopping the hearts of rats and rabbits and things like that

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former US Army sergeant, told podcast host Jesse Michels about the Soviet Union's work on mind powers. He says the Russians had a woman named Nina Kulagina who could stop the hearts of rats, rabbits and other animals, apparently with her mind alone. If true, it would mean the mind can directly harm a living body.
